title: Promotion Sets
description:
## A flexible system for creating promotional offers by combining different components and rules.

It should not only be possible to define the conditions in a promotion set, but also to include or exclude products and categories. At the same time, it should be possible to add components for the store frontend (banners, selection flags, etc.).

### **The promotion set controls the logic and also the UI.**

This makes it possible, for example, that the user only has to select a color once for a promotion (e.g. pink for Valentine's Day) and the associated elements such as flags, promo banners, etc. are automatically adjusted.

Users can also control the scope of the display in the front end. For example, whether flags should also be displayed on categories (category nodes) and up to what level. This also includes a timing for setting the promotion live and taking it off again.

It should be possible to create several promotion sets and to have parallel promotions.

---

## Main Benefits

* **Unified Control:** Single point of management for both promotional logic and visual presentation
* **Consistency:** Automated coordination of visual elements (banners, flags, colors) across all promotional touchpoints
* **Flexibility:** Support for multiple concurrent promotions with different rules and presentations
* **Time Efficiency:** Reduced setup time through automated application of visual elements and rules
* **Granular Control:** Precise management of promotion visibility, timing, and scope across the platform

---

## Core Components

* **Product and Category Selection**

    * Individual products
    * Product categories
    * Brand-specific items
    * Price ranges
    
* **Discount Types**

    * Percentage off
    * Fixed amount off
    * Buy X Get Y
    * Bundle pricing
    * Discount Code
    
        * with fixed percentage off
        * with fixed amount off
        
    

---

## Rule System

* **Quantity Rules**

    * Minimum purchase amount
    * Maximum discount amount
    * Items per customer
    
* **Timing Rules**

    * Valid date range
    * Time of day restrictions
    * Day of week applicability
    
* **Customer Rules**

    * Member-only promotions
    * First-time customer offers
    * Loyalty tier requirements
    

---

## Implementation Notes

* Sets should be easily configurable through an admin interface
* Rules should be stackable and prioritized
* System must validate rule conflicts
* Real-time calculation of discounts
* Clear display of active promotions to customers

---

## Monitoring and Analytics

* Track usage patterns
* **Measure promotion effectiveness**
* Monitor discount amounts
* Analyze customer behavior
